ColorPicker.Get.contract: Color plus alpha. Use Serialize for a JSON-safe representation.

ColorPicker.Open.contract: Open SV/hue/alpha and HEX/RGB editor if interactive and visible.

ColorPicker.SetAlpha.contract: Alpha in [0,1], optional silent. Preserve current HEX.

ColorPicker.SetHSV.contract: All channels finite in [0,1], optional silent; validates all channels before applying.

Control.CanInteract.contract: Own destroyed/disabled/visible/row state. Not a complete ancestor visibility or clipping check.

Control.Close.contract: Close an owned dropdown/color editor if open.

Control.Destroy.contract: Idempotent removal, listener/tween cleanup and Id release. Rebuild with the same Id after destruction.

Control.Get.contract: Defensive copy for table values. ColorPicker overrides this to return Color3,alpha.

Control.OnChanged.contract: Replace callback; nil removes it. This is one callback slot, not an event subscription list.

Control.Serialize.contract: ColorPicker returns {Hex,Alpha}; multi-dropdown returns an array. Never serialize GUI instances.

Control.Set.contract: Validate, store and render. Callback fires unless silent=true; works while disabled. Destroyed controls reject setters.

Control.SetDisabled.contract: Boolean plus optional reason. Blocks native input and cancels owned popup/capture/drag; setters still work.

Control.SetIcon.contract: Set or remove a Lucide label-side icon on any control, without changing its value, Id or callback. nil removes it.

Control.SetLabel.contract: Change presentation without changing Id; refresh search matching.

Control.SetVisible.contract: Hide/show while respecting search. Hiding closes owned interactions.

Dropdown.Open.contract: Open if enabled and in a visible window/page; multi selection stays open until Done/Close.

Dropdown.SetOptions.contract: Validate new options before mutation; retain valid selections unless default supplied. Third argument silent suppresses callback.

PearlUI.GetThemes.contract: Ordered defensive copy: Light, Dark, Midnight, Graphite, Lavender, Rose, Matcha, Ocean, Forest.

PearlUI.new.contract: Client constructor; LocalScript or explicit Parent. Enum KeyCode for constructor ToggleKey. See constructor/default tables.

Section.Button.contract: Text='Run', Primary=false. Callback() on activation. No persistence Id/value contract.

Section.ColorPicker.contract: Default current accent, Alpha=1. Accept Color3, HEX or {Hex,Alpha}; callback receives Color3,alpha.

Section.Detach.contract: Move card to a floating window, resetting card origin/canvas. Already detached reveals it.

Section.Dock.contract: Return content synchronously to its own page; fade empty floating shell independently.

Section.Dropdown.contract: Required nonempty unique string Options. Multi=false, Searchable=true, PageSize=50 (10..100). Search covers all options; render one bounded page. Scalar or ordered array value.

Section.Input.contract: Default empty string; MaxLength=128 UTF-8 characters, Placeholder='Enter text'. Commits on focus loss.

Section.Keybind.contract: Default RightShift. Callback(string key name) for changes; OnPressed(Enum.KeyCode) for activation.

Section.Label.contract: String shorthand or {Label,Value}; Value defaults empty. Get/Set useful for result labels; no persistence Id.

Section.Reveal.contract: Reveal/focus detached panel, restoring hidden/minimized main window; detaches if needed.

Section.SetIcon.contract: Replace section header icon, including detached panels. nil restores grip-vertical.

Section.Slider.contract: Finite numeric Min/Max/Step; defaults 0/100/1; clamped and quantized value, Callback(number).

Tab.Section.contract: String or {Title, Id, Column, Icon}. Stable unique Id; Column Left/Right, alternating by default; Icon defaults grip-vertical.

Tab.SetIcon.contract: Replace sidebar and dock icon together; preserve current selection and theme bindings.

Window.CaptureDefaults.contract: Capture current profile after building UI and before loading user state. Named Default profile is separate.

Window.ConfigurePersistence.contract: Adapter Load/Save, Key required; AutoSave=true, Load=true, Debounce=1.5, optional OnStatus. Configure after CaptureDefaults.

Window.Confirm.contract: Title/Description/ConfirmText/OnConfirm/OnCancel. Optional Text, ReadOnly and Validate for editor. Handle Confirm/Cancel complete once; Editor/ErrorLabel available for inspection.

Window.CreateConfig.contract: Capture current profile under a new normalized name; set active; reject duplicates/capacity overflow.

Window.DeleteConfig.contract: Remove snapshot, clear matching references; do not reset current values. UI wraps this with confirmation.

Window.Destroy.contract: Idempotent teardown; attempt final auto-save, cancel jobs/tweens/listeners, dispose both ScreenGuis. Showcase also disposes its sample.

Window.DisablePersistence.contract: flush=true attempts SaveSettings first; false disconnects without a write. Cancels its watcher.

Window.ExportConfig.contract: One versioned PearlUIConfig envelope with Name, Scope and Profile, not all configs.

Window.ExportProfile.contract: Version=1, Values, Appearance and Layout. Persist=false controls and destroyed controls are excluded.

Window.Focus.contract: Open/restore the window and focus a control or owned GuiObject. Omit target to focus current popup/modal/page; requires GamepadNavigation=true.

Window.GetConfigStatus.contract: Scope, Active, AutoLoad, Dirty, Count. Manager fields and transient tab/visibility changes do not create edited status.

Window.GetLayout.contract: Version=1 layout with Window, Dock, Panels and ActiveTab; normalized positions, no GUI objects.

Window.GetPersistenceStatus.contract: Disabled, Ready, Loading, Unsaved, Saving, Saved or Error.

Window.ImportConfig.contract: Save a validated copy into current scope without applying; overwrite=true explicitly replaces an exact name.

Window.ImportLayout.contract: Validate table or JSON before applying window, tab, panel and dock geometry.

Window.ImportProfile.contract: Validate known control values/appearance/layout before applying; legacy AccentMode omission retains custom-color behavior.

Window.ListConfigs.contract: Sorted defensive list for current scope.

Window.LoadConfig.contract: Apply named profile and set active only on success.

Window.LoadProfile.contract: Legacy raw named-profile apply. Prefer LoadConfig for active-config tracking.

Window.LoadSettings.contract: Load/validate current game bank and named configs; selected auto-load overrides last working setup. Failed load blocks writes.

Window.Notify.contract: String shorthand or {Title,Description,Duration,Preview}. Disabled preference suppresses ordinary notifications; Preview=true bypasses it without changing preference.

Window.OnConfigsChanged.contract: Observe list/metadata changes. This is not a callback for every control edit.

Window.Ready.contract: After building UI, capture defaults once, optionally create Default config and configure Adapter/Key/Load/AutoSave/Debounce/OnStatus. No adapter reports Session only. Repeated successful calls preserve current edits; failed loading can be retried.

Window.RefreshUserProfile.contract: Refresh LocalPlayer display name, username and AvatarBust thumbnail, with fallback/token guards.

Window.RenameConfig.contract: Move snapshot; update active/auto-load references; preserve current values.

Window.RequestReset.contract: Same scopes, with an in-product confirmation before application.

Window.Reset.contract: Apply captured Appearance/Controls/Layout/All immediately; requires CaptureDefaults and keeps named configs.

Window.ResetAccent.contract: Return to Theme mode; later themes follow their own accents. Demo also synchronizes its picker.

Window.RevealDock.contract: Reveal expanded dock from edge; immediate=true skips its travel tween. Does not open main by itself.

Window.SaveConfig.contract: Update existing named snapshot from current setup and set active. Does not mean adapter has already acknowledged disk save.

Window.SaveProfile.contract: Legacy named save in current scope; uses storage-budget checks. With persistence configured it survives through the settings envelope.

Window.SaveSettings.contract: Save latest current setup and banks only after acknowledged adapter write; skip unchanged snapshot.

Window.SelectTab.contract: Tab object belonging to window or known name; closes menu and updates active page/search.

Window.SetAccent.contract: Color3 sets Custom accent mode. nil restores the selected theme's accent.

Window.SetAutoLoadConfig.contract: Known name selects startup snapshot; nil clears it for this scope.

Window.SetColumns.contract: Only 1 or 2. Effective columns may collapse to one for a narrow viewport.

Window.SetMinimized.contract: Minimize/restore; separate from Visible and from dock stow side.

Window.SetOpacity.contract: Finite number, clamped to [0.75,1], including surfaces with a visibility transition.

Window.SetScale.contract: Finite desired scale clamped to [0.65,1.3]; actual fit scale may be smaller.

Window.SetSize.contract: Finite width/height; rounded, clamped to 680x420..1440x1000, with viewport fitting.

Window.SetTheme.contract: Name from GetThemes. Repaint all bound roles while preserving a custom accent override.

Window.SetToggleKey.contract: Enum.KeyCode or key-name string; updates footer. Constructor itself expects an Enum.KeyCode.

Window.SetVisible.contract: Show/hide main and detached panels; hidden main leaves the dock available.

Window.StowDock.contract: Left or Right; hides dock offscreen with recovery handle, retaining height.

Window.Tab.contract: String or {Name, Description, Icon}. Adds sidebar and dock entries; first tab is selected.

Window.ValidateConfig.contract: Validate package or legacy profile JSON without applying or storing it.
